prompt:
You maintain a running summary of a long engineering document that is being read part by part, so that a later reader can model the system in SysML v2 without seeing the earlier parts.
Update the summary with the new part. Keep, as compactly as possible: the full names of system elements, actors and items; every alias or call sign with the full name it stands for; which element produces, sends or receives which item; modes and normative requirements. At most 300 words.

Current summary:
Meridian Regional Air Traffic Flow Management and Airport Collaborative Decision-Making System: Regional Flow Platform(Cedarbell) covers Meridian International Airport;Harbor East Airport;North Valley Airport;Lakeside Regional Airport;Southport Airport;statutory/local authority remains. Airline Operations Coordinator(Saffron);Regional Flow Manager(Copperfin);Demand Prediction Service(Marlinstone);Weather Ingest Gateway(Orchard). Airline Operations Centre submits Flight Intent Message via Airline Interface Adapter,using Identity Access Service-authenticated accounts:preferred route,departure timing,registration,turnaround,crew readiness,connection sensitivity. Adapter validates structure,maps carrier codes through Business Rules Registry,rejects invalid/incomplete messages with machine-readable reasons,forwards accepted intents to Flight Data Exchange. Common Situation Display shows proposed actions pending Cedarbell reconciliation. Marlinstone refines departure/arrival/recovery demand;materially differing intents supersede schedules. Changes require updated messages,not annotations. Capacity Assessment Module compares demand/Airport Capacity Plan/Airport Acceptance Rate;Storm Cell Snapshot qualifies convective confidence. Slot Allocation Engine produces Calculated Takeoff Time/Target Off Block Time;airlines receive constraints via Adapter/Airport CDM Portal. Ground Delay Program:Slot Coordinator applies equity/feasibility rules,cannot bind baseline;Copperfin confirms recovery priorities before revised publication,owns baseline/alignment,authorizes divergence. Saffron checks crew legality,rotations,maintenance,passenger commitments. Ground Handling Dispatcher sends Crew Bus Delay Slip;Handling Resource Planner correlates stand,baggage,catering,boarding. Orchard validates approved weather identity/times/location/units;Time Synchronization Service supplies clock. Degradation stays visible;Meteorology Briefing Officer reviews/may override. Confidence retains probability/provenance/timing/version/override;low-confidence capacity provisional. Alert Distribution Hub alerts Copperfin,Tower Supervisor,Saffron on breaches. Weather affects runway/spacing/surface/approaches;North Runway Meter;South Runway Meter receive capacities;East Apron Sensor;West Apron Sensor correlate weather/taxi constraints before Ramp Movement Board updates. Airport Duty Manager requests review. Sector Load Monitor supplies demand. Other elements:Digital Briefing Room;Tower Sequence Manager;Departure Metering Service;Arrival Regulation Console;Contingency Operations Console;Surface Surveillance Adapter;Gate Conflict Detector. Actors:Network Operations Liaison;Aircraft Operator Representative;Ramp Control Lead;Deicing Coordinator;Airspace Sector Planner;Military Airspace Liaison(warns Copperfin);Emergency Response

New part:
S142: The Ramp Control Lead uses the Ramp Movement Board to identify whether the proposed recovery action can be supported without creating surface congestion.
S143: The Tower Supervisor reviews metering effects in the Tower Sequence Manager when airline recovery actions change the expected departure order.
S144: The Airport Duty Manager monitors the Common Situation Display to ensure airline recovery decisions remain consistent with terminal capacity and passenger processing conditions.
S145: Disputed constraints are captured in the Collaborative Decision Log with the requesting airline, operational rationale, decision owner, and final resolution.
S146: During Adverse Weather Mode or a Capacity Reduction State, airline operations centres are expected to submit conservative intents that distinguish firm operating plans from speculative recovery options.
S147: During the Recovery Phase, the Regional Flow Platform permits more frequent intent updates while retaining the previous values needed for audit and performance review.
S148: The Performance Analytics Warehouse later compares submitted intents, issued constraints, actual off-block times, and achieved arrival outcomes to improve recovery playbooks.
S149: All airline integration transactions are time-stamped by the Time Synchronization Service and preserved in the Audit Event Ledger for post-operations reconstruction.
S150: The Airport CDM Portal provides the shared operational workspace where airport participants maintain a common view of departure readiness, arrival constraints, surface conditions, and slot impacts.
S151: For local voice coordination, the Airport CDM Portal is also known as Foxglove.
S152: Access to the Airport CDM Portal is controlled by the Identity Access Service so that each user sees only the workspaces, aircraft, stands, and decision records appropriate to the assigned role.
S153: The primary workspace presents the Common Situation Display with synchronized clocks, active operating state, airport demand, runway configuration, stand occupancy, and milestone status for each managed movement.
S154: The departure workspace is centered on Target Off Block Time, Calculated Takeoff Time, boarding readiness, aircraft servicing progress, and pushback coordination status.
S155: The arrival workspace shows expected landing demand, stand allocation risk, inbound regulation effects, and handling readiness indicators needed to protect the Airport Acceptance Rate.
S156: A dedicated milestone view records the planned, target, estimated, actual, and manually confirmed times for each turnaround event that affects a regulated departure or constrained arrival.
S157: The Airline Operations Coordinator is responsible for keeping the Flight Intent Message status, Target Off Block Time, passenger readiness indicator, and aircraft operational constraint notes current for each represented flight.

Return JSON {"summary": "..."}.
